original.statement: Istio fixed support for clusterLocal host exclusions in multi-cluster setups.

corrected.statement: Istio 1.24.0 fixed support for clusterLocal host exclusions in multi-cluster setups, changing how those exclusions behave (protocol-behavior clusterlocal-host-exclusions-multi-cluster, behavior-changed).

decision.reason: [ev-4407ed95f094] only says "Fixed Support clusterLocal host exclusions for multi-cluster". That is a bugfix to existing behaviour with no key, field or component named, so a free-form protocol-behavior subject with change type behavior-changed (no before/after values) is the most the evidence supports. The free-form name has to be built from the evidence's own words, and "multi-cluster" kebab-cases to "multi-cluster", not "multicluster". So the subject name is corrected to clusterlocal-host-exclusions-multi-cluster.
